⚠️ Can XRP price hold $1.40 as U.S. ETFs add $3.14M?

📊 XRP has fallen toward $1.45 after U.S. spot XRP ETFs added $3.14 million on Oct. 6, leaving traders focused on $1.40 support after a sharp market selloff. CoinGecko shows XRP trading around $1.45, down 4.3% over 24 hours and 3.9% during the past seven days. Trading volume stands near $2.24 billion, while roughly 63 billion XRP in circulation gives the token a market capitalization above $91 billion.

🌐 Tuesday’s ETF flows arrived before XRP dropped from roughly $1.52 to $1.46 during a fast crypto selloff early Wednesday. SoSoValue data U.S. spot XRP funds recorded $3.1404 million in net inflows on Oct. 6. Bitwise accounted for $10.5514 million of inflows, while Franklin’s XRPZ recorded a $4.0702 million withdrawal. Bitwise’s positive session lifted its cumulative XRP ETF inflows to roughly $688 million. Franklin’s fund retained approximately $501 million in historical net inflows despite Tuesday’s withdrawal. Other funds collectively accounted for the remaining outflows needed to bring the daily total down to $3.14 million.

🔗 Total cumulative inflows into U.S. spot XRP ETFs reached $1.794 billion, while the funds held roughly $1.697 billion in net assets. SoSoValue placed the XRP net asset ratio at 1.79%. The ETF data preceded the price decline. XRP fell from approximately $1.52 to $1.46 during the early-Oct. 7 market selloff, while Bitcoin slipped below $84,000. The move occurred during a period of heavy crypto long liquidations.

🔔 Glimpse Is Back — Now Live With No KYC Required

💥 Glimpse has re-registered in Panama, and the move removes one of the biggest friction points for new and returning traders: signing up and trading on the platform no longer requires KYC.

💸 The core mechanics stay exactly the same. Instead of buying or shorting Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana or Gold, you forecast the price range an asset will trade in — and get paid out in Bitcoin when your call is accurate. That means there's an opportunity whether the market climbs, drops, or goes sideways, not just during the big moves.

📊 Deposits and withdrawals still run on the Lightning Network, so transactions stay fast. With KYC out of the way, getting started now takes minutes.

If you checked out Glimpse before and stepped away, this is a good moment to come back — same markets, same payout mechanics, just a much faster way in.
